parameters: Lysander...\| I wondered how long it would take for you to do something like this.
I can't let you take the Lightfury.\! You may be unleashing the end times upon the world.
What exactly do you think this is all about?\! You think I have some sinister plan?

You Nephilim have been answering his call.\! That voice you keep hearing...\| That is Zanatus.\! The power that courses through your weapons, and the Lightfury...\| They gained their power as they became awash in the blood of the dark god.
Casamir is dead. You've won the war, and the world is already yours.\! You need but relish in your victory... the people still desire you, the hero of our time.
You know how I feel about prophecy...\| but following it so far has been the right thing.\! How do you know it isn't your actions that would result in some Armageddon?
I'm sorry, Lysander.\! I won't be leaving.
Your unchecked ambition cannot be ignored forever...\| everyone else might be scared of you, but someone must take a stand.
What do you think? I-I made it myself.\! You won't be able to move for a while...\! Then we will be able to deal with you without unnecessary risk.\! Aren't you impressed, Beatrix?!
I'm so sorry, \n[8]...\| You're under the spell of evil...
\n[8]...\| I'm so sorry, this is happening so fast. They told me you'll be okay. I'll be there for you when this is all over...
Do not be afraid, \n[8]. Even though this appears to be the only way forward, I will not allow any harm to come to you.
Did you hear me, Jebediah? Lest you wish to be cut to ribbons by my blade, you will honor your word. Do not cross me, little man.
...Narima... what in the world lead you to believe this is the only way?!

I... I couldn't help it, \n[8]! I'm supposed to be on the good guy side, right?!\! But then, everything happened so fast, and now Lysander wants us to "put a check" on you, whatever.\! Don't worry, you'll be fine, they said they'd let you leave!
...Sybil... what in the world lead you to go along with this?!
Ready your weapons, Nephilim...\| the cult will have no mercy for us.
What are you waiting for?\! I've broken your spell... fight by my side!!
Lysander...\| you really did it, didn't you?!
I could not convince you. It seems you are determined to take the Lightfury...\| and destroy yourself, and possibly, all there is.
Sheesh, is that what I'm doing? What makes you want to be around such a monster, anyway?

\n[8]... you can still come back from this. Those people in Armitage, they hated Casamir's regime, and you saved them!\! You're not a monster... but now I see that your destiny is clashing against that of the rest of Tahnra's...\! Zanatus's power flows through these Nephilim weapons... please don't do this, \n[8]. Let him languish in defeat, and in obscurity, forever.

I'm sorry, Lysander. I'm determined to see this through.\! But I need you by my side for this, more than ever... please.
